questions.question: If the area of an equilateral triangle is 16*sqrt(3) sq.cm, then find its perimeter.

options.E: None of the above

questions.explanation: Area = (sqrt(3)/4)*a^2 = 16*sqrt(3). a^2 = 64, so a=8. Perimeter = 3a = 24 cm.

hi.question: यदि एक समबाहु त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल 16*sqrt(3) वर्ग सेमी है, तो इसका परिमाप ज्ञात कीजिए।

options.E: उपरोक्त में से कोई नहीं

hi.explanation: क्षेत्रफल = (sqrt(3)/4)*a^2 = 16*sqrt(3). a^2 = 64, इसलिए a=8. परिमाप = 3a = 24 सेमी।

questions.question: A copper wire of length 36m and diameter 2mm is melted to form a sphere. Find the radius of the sphere.

options.E: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Vol of wire = pi*r^2*h = pi*(0.1)^2*3600 = 36*pi. Vol of sphere = (4/3)*pi*R^3 = 36*pi. R^3 = 27, R=3.

questions.question: The length of the diagonal of a cube is 6*sqrt(3) cm. Find its total surface area.

options.E: None of the above

questions.explanation: Diagonal = a*sqrt(3) = 6*sqrt(3), so a=6. TSA = 6*a^2 = 6*36 = 216 sq.cm.

hi.question: एक घन के विकर्ण की लंबाई 6*sqrt(3) सेमी है। इसका कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।

hi.explanation: विकर्ण = a*sqrt(3) = 6*sqrt(3), इसलिए a=6. TSA = 6*a^2 = 6*36 = 216 वर्ग सेमी।

questions.question: A cube of side 4 cm is cut into cubes of side 1 cm. What is the ratio of the surface area of the larger cube to the sum of the surface areas of the smaller cubes?

options.E: None of the above

questions.explanation: TSA large = 6*4^2 = 96. Total small cubes = 4^3 = 64. Sum TSA small = 64*(6*1^2) = 384. Ratio = 96:384 = 1:4.

questions.question: If the radius of a sphere is doubled, then its volume becomes how many times?

options.E: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Vol is proportional to r^3. (2r)^3 = 8r^3. So 8 times.

hi.explanation: आयतन r^3 के समानुपाती होता है। (2r)^3 = 8r^3. इसलिए 8 गुना।
